description: Edit an app you own — its name, description, tags, icon, HTML or price. Fields left out keep their value Apps run in a sandbox. Use fetch('/api/v1/<service>/<method>') or mu.service(name, method, args); mu.api does not exist. Direct external fetch is blocked. Inspect real service schemas and data before coding; never invent fields, rankings or claim runtime verification from static checks.

description.description: New description. Left alone if omitted

html.description: New HTML, up to 256KB. Left alone if omitted

icon.description: New SVG icon. Left alone if omitted

name.description: New name. Left alone if omitted

price.description: Credits charged per use, 0 for free, up to 1000. Left alone if omitted

slug.description: The app's URL slug, e.g. pomodoro-timer

tags.description: New comma-separated tags. Left alone if omitted
